doc: Every refusal, stop or exclusion site on the HAZARD_PACK path, found mechanically by
tests/hazards/refusal_census.py, keyed by (file, function, kind, detail) with an exact count.
Each entry's guard is a digest of the conditions leading to its sites (enclosing if/while/
conditional tests and except types), so widening an existing refusal changes it.
tests/hazards/test_refusal_allowlist.py fails on a site not listed here, a stale entry, a count
or guard that differs, a scanned module depending on a first-party file that is neither scanned
nor in not_scanned, a computed-name module load not in dynamic_loads, and an EXCLUDE_WINDOW or
EXCLUDE_MEMBER code missing from window_exclusions or member_exclusions.
Doctrine (Ed, 2026-10-05): physics refuses; everything else is a flag.  A new entry is
PHYSICS (name the physical quantity), NUMBER_INTEGRITY (name the number it protects) or
INTERNAL (it never stops collection: name where it is caught or why it cannot fire).
A reviewer's 'fail closed' on any other condition is dispositioned 'flag, not refuse'
(night-archive/gate-prune/REVIEW_BRIEF_RULE.md).  BASELINE marks sites already present at
e6b6a0ce (the gate-prune sweep's base, whose reachable refusals SWEEP.md classified) and
unchanged at ba0e0c72e; the census did not review them one by one.  Each BASELINE entry must
match a line of tests/hazards/refusal_baseline_frozen.txt (key, guard, count no higher), so a
changed or new BASELINE entry fails: review it into another category.  Every site added between e6b6a0ce and ba0e0c72e was
classified by the 2026-10-06 refusal census ('added' names the commit).
DEFERRED_REPRESENTATION is a known representation refusal with a named owner lane fixing it.

categories.PHYSICS: refuses on a measured physical hazard; protects names the quantity
categories.NUMBER_INTEGRITY: refuses because a number would be wrong or unattributable; protects names the number
categories.INTERNAL: never stops collection or excludes a window; protects names the catcher or why
categories.DEFERRED_REPRESENTATION: a representation refusal another lane is converting; owner names it
categories.BASELINE: present at e6b6a0ce and unchanged; not individually reviewed; frozen totals

calibration.acceptance_mismatch.protects: the window's calibration captures must match the instrument acceptance the fiducial bound was judged under

calibration.binding_failed.protects: the bracket session must bind this window's plan, runs root and window id

calibration.bracket_acceptance_failed.protects: the pre/post bracket must pass its acceptance (instrument drift across the window)

calibration.capture_battery_pair_failed.protects: battery float (on AC, not charging) during a calibration capture, re-derived from the capture's raw ioreg pair

calibration.capture_battery_span.protects: battery charge or discharge over a calibration capture span (continuous battery journal)

calibration.capture_battery_unmeasured.protects: no battery reading covers a non-passing calibration capture span: battery state during the capture unmeasured

calibration.capture_invalid.protects: a calibration capture's bytes differ from its recorded digests, or its fit is invalid

calibration.historical_custody_mismatch.protects: an earlier calibration capture that the screen basis and acceptance preflight read has PRESENT bytes that differ from the ledger hash; evicted (absent) captures are calibration.historical_custody_unmeasured (DISCLOSE) since the 2026-10-06 refusal census

calibration.ledger_snapshot_refused.protects: the harvest's ledger snapshot is not the chain the acceptance and bracket were judged on: the acceptance's cutoff entry is not in it (calibration_ledger_baseline_missing), the ledger changed between the terminal-pin read and the snapshot (head_mismatch, rollback), or chain bytes do not parse or conflict. Record-state reasons cannot reach it: the governed writer refuses to append past any ledger reason, terminal_head_pin_for_session refuses parse and state reasons first (calibration.no_bracket), and the call skips the committed-pin and custody checks

calibration.no_bracket.protects: no finalized bracket session for the window: no drift bound for its numbers

calibration.session_not_bound.protects: the bracket session does not bind this window

cell.below_minimum.protects: fewer valid members in a cell than the registered minimum (statistical power of the reported number)

clock.step_overlap_calibration.protects: a clock step overlapping a calibration capture

clock.systematic.protects: the clock systematic exceeds the registered budget for the reported energy

code.executed_differs_from_sealed.protects: the executed measurement code differs from the sealed code

g3.recompute_failed.protects: the G3 independent recompute of the window's numbers failed

instrument.precal_screen_failed.protects: the pre-calibration screen (0.03646 s fiducial bound) failed

lineage.plan_tree_digest_differs.protects: the executed plan tree differs from the sealed pack

model.identity_inconsistent_in_window.protects: members of one window ran different model weights

model.identity_unmeasured.protects: which model weights produced the numbers could not be established at arm and the harvest could not re-derive it (the harvest supersedes the arm flag when it re-derives)

neg8.screen_failed.protects: the NEG-8 drift screen failed for the window

pack.identity_mismatch.protects: the executed pack differs from the sealed pack
